read.en: Meta rose 2.6% on Oct 13 to $762.50, its second straight gain, after a high of $771.27. It is above all its averages: the 5 and 10-day ($733.3 and $732.6), the 30-day ($694.9), 200-day ($631.0) and 100-day ($624.4). MACD is still below its signal (since Oct 2) but the histogram is narrowing toward a bullish cross, Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Oct 13 ($711.7), and RSI is 66.
read.zh: Meta 10月13日上涨 2.6%，收于 $762.50，连续第二日上涨，盘中高点 $771.27。股价位于所有均线上方：5 日和 10 日（$733.3 和 $732.6）、30 日（$694.9）、200 日（$631.0）及 100 日均线（$624.4）。MACD 仍位于信号线下方（自 10月2日起），但柱状图收窄、趋近金叉，抛物线 SAR 于 10月13日转为看多（$711.7），RSI 为 66。

read.en: The $748–752 resistance (Oct 6 and Oct 12 highs) gave way and now serves as first support. The next resistance is $771 (Oct 13 high), then the $780 record from Sep 24; a close above $780 would put the stock at a new high. Support is $750, then $733 (5 and 10-day averages) and $712 (Oct 8 low and SAR).
read.zh: $748–752 阻力（10月6日及 10月12日高点）被突破，现转为第一支撑。下一阻力为 $771（10月13日高点），其次为 9月24日创下的 $780 纪录高点；若收盘站上 $780，股价将创新高。支撑为 $750，其次 $733（5 日和 10 日均线）和 $712（10月8日低点及 SAR）。

s.en: Oct 6 and Oct 12 highs ($748–752), now support
